name: @yordan/design-system
description: AI-ready, repo-first design system for the blueprint portfolio. Source of truth: tokens/tokens.json + components/*/spec.md + css/components.css. See README.md.
//: `private: true` and no `publishConfig`: this is consumed by `file:`, never from a registry. `version` is still real — scripts/contract-diff.mjs enforces it against the committed contract in RELEASED.json, so a consumer pinning a range gets a semver promise a publish step would otherwise have to make. `exports` is the same statement the boundary gate makes: dist/ and css/ are published, everything else here is private, and a subpath not listed below is unreachable rather than merely undocumented. `assets/` is in `files` and NOT in `exports` on purpose — avatar.svg is fetched by URL from markup, never resolved as a module.
//exports: ELEVEN subpaths, and it was six until phase R2a. The five new ones are the Tailwind + React tier: tokens.tailwind.css binds Tailwind v4's @theme namespaces to the custom properties tokens.css already defines, and ./react/<id> is one generated, typed component per pilot definition. They are ENUMERATED rather than a `./react/*` wildcard for the same reason the other six are: a subpath that is not listed is unreachable, and a wildcard would publish whatever happens to land in the directory. The React entries resolve to .tsx SOURCE — a consumer transpiles them (Next: transpilePackages) and brings class-variance-authority and react itself; this package still declares no dependencies.

scripts.//emit: PHASE R1 PILOT. Three components (button, chip, stat) have their appearance authored as data in components/<id>/definition.json, and their blocks in css/components.css are GENERATED regions rendered from it. `emit:css` writes them; `build.mjs --check` re-renders them in memory and byte-compares, so a hand-edit inside a region fails the build. It runs first in `build` for the obvious reason — the check that follows would otherwise be comparing against a stale file. It is deliberately NOT a step of the ROOT `npm run build`: see the header of scripts/emit-css.mjs.
scripts.build: node scripts/emit-css.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --check
scripts.//test: Both gates build storybook-static when it is stale, serve it on an ephemeral port and drive @storybook/test-runner against it — no dev server, and no http-server/wait-on/concurrently. CI needs `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium` first. NEITHER joins the root `npm run check`: that gate is offline, browser-free and dependency-light, and these two need Chromium. test:visual is REPORT-ONLY until 2026-09-01 — see .storybook/test-runner.js.
